title.zh: Q-Day Could Arrive Before Quantum Computers Are Commercially Useful, EU Warns
title.en: Q-Day Could Arrive Before Quantum Computers Are Commercially Useful, EU Warns

current_state.zh: EU banking, insurance, and markets regulators warned that a cryptographically relevant quantum computer could arrive before commercial quantum utility, urging member states to adopt post-quantum cryptography migration strategies by the end of 2026 to counter 'harvest now, decrypt later' threats to blockchains and financial systems.
